subject: Renewal proposal — capacity & latency guardrails
body:
From: Priya Shah <priya@acme.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Contract renewal & support options

Hi Olga,

We’re approaching our June renewal and I wanted to start the conversation about upgrading our support SLA and increasing committed capacity. Over the last 9 months our production footprint has grown ~3.6x and we’re seeing more tail latency variability during peak windows. High-level asks: 

- Move to a Premium SLA with a tighter latency SLO for inference (95th < 150ms for our typical sequence length).
- Reserve a baseline of 4x our current GPU capacity with burstable headroom for seasonal spikes.
- Clarify maintenance windows and impact to in-flight requests during model rollouts.
- Visibility: extended audit logs and token-level cost breakdown for the committed period.

I’ve attached our renewal requirements (Acme_Renewal_Q2.pdf). Can we get a proposal that outlines cost delta, SLO language, and a migration plan (non-disruptive canary/rollout)?

Thanks,
Priya Shah
Head of ML Ops, Acme AI
priya@acme.ai

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acme.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 28 May 2028 12:40:14 -0000
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & support options

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear breakdown and the attachment. High level response below and proposed next steps.

What we can offer:
- Premium SLA (Priority+): 99.5% uptime SLA, committed reserved capacity sizing, and a 95th-percentile inference latency SLO target of <150ms for your production model family at the agreed baseline seq length. We’ll include penalty language tied to monthly availability and p95 windows in the amendment.
- Capacity: baseline reservation = 4x current committed vGPU units (details in capacity-cost-model.xlsx). Burst capacity available up to 6x for short windows with priority routing.
- Rollout plan: we recommend a staged canary over a 2-week window — traffic mirroring, KV/prefix cache warmup, then 1% → 10% → 50% → 100% routing with health checks. During the canary we’ll pin a rollback playbook and a temporary fallback to a compatible lower-quantized variant if latency spikes.
- Observability: extended retention for token-level traces and per-route latency insights for the committed period.

Commercials / incentives:
- 10% onboarding credit if you commit to 12 months of the new reserved baseline.
- Option for a 6-month pilot at committed baseline + burst (convertible to 12-month term).

Next steps:
1) Schedule a technical kickoff (Marissa leads the ops/onboarding plan).
2) Ben will share an initial quote and amendment draft (quote-RDW-12847.pdf).
3) We’ll provide DocuSign for the amendment and a SLO appendix for legal review.

I’m copying Marissa (CS) and Ben (Sales) to align on schedule. If that sounds good, we can aim for a technical call next week.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Head of Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

Attachment: redwood-premium-sla-diff.pdf, capacity-cost-model.xlsx

Date: Wed, 29 May 2028 08:07:22 -0000
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & support options — preliminary commercials

Priya / Olga — following up with the proposed commercial structure for deal RDW-12847. Quick bullets: 

- Baseline reserved (4x): pricing = $XX,XXX / month.
- Burst capacity on-demand: $YY / vGPU-hour with priority queueing.
- Pilot (6 months) pricing = baseline discounted by 7% + onboarding credit (10% once committed to 12-month conversion).
- Legal amendment will include SLO appendix and a one-time onboarding credit line item.

I’ve attached quote-RDW-12847.pdf with line-item detail and a stretch quote if you want a faster response SLA (sub-100ms at 95th) — that would require additional capacity or smarter quantization strategies.

Suggested meeting times: https://calendly.com/redwood/rdw-renewal-call

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Director, Account Sales — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

---
From: Priya Shah <priya@acme.ai>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Gomez <agomez@acme.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 10:15:09 -0000
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & support options

Thanks Olga & Ben — this looks promising. A couple of clarifying items before we lock the pilot: 

- Maintenance windows: please confirm whether model swap/rolling update requires a hard pause for in-flight requests or if you support zero-downtime swap with session affinity. We run long-lived sessions and need low disruption.
- Data residency: our compliance team needs confirmation that logs for the committed period will remain in us-east-1 and that KMS keys are customer-managed.
- Can we add our security lead Alex (copied) to the kickoff so he can vet the SLO appendix and the audit log retention plan?

If we can get the DocuSign amendment and a short tech kickoff next week, we’ll aim to sign before the renewal window closes.

Cheers,
Priya

---
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@acme.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 01 Jun 2028 16:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Contract renewal & support options — next steps and kickoff

Priya — quick update / summary of action items so everything is in one place.

Action items:
- Redwood to provide DocuSign amendment (SLO appendix + capacity schedule) — link: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/amendment/RDW-12847 (attached to this thread).
- Marissa to schedule technical kickoff and ops runbook review (Calendly link above).
- Ben to confirm pricing line items and apply onboarding credit once 12-month conversion is signed.
- Security: logs will be retained in us-east-1 by default; we support customer-managed KMS for the committed term. Marissa will route the KMS key integration checklist to Alex ahead of the kickoff.
- Rollout: 2-week canary with rollback playbook; zero-downtime swaps supported via traffic mirroring and session affinity where feasible — we’ll validate with your session patterns on the kickoff.

Please sign the amendment when convenient and we’ll lock the pilot start date the week after sign.

Best,
Olga

Attachments referenced: Acme_Renewal_Q2.pdf, redwood-premium-sla-diff.pdf, capacity-cost-model.xlsx, quote-RDW-12847.pdf
